## About
Brett & Sons Plumbing does residential and commercial plumbing from our spot on Research Blvd in Austin. We dig up yard leaks, clear backed-up drains, swap out water heaters and set up whole-home filtration.
Customers tell us they value straight answers. One reviewer with an older home said we went over a long list of concerns with honesty and patience, and offered a few smart ways to keep the cost down. Another said the plumber explained how their well and filtration setup worked in simple terms.
We hold a 4.9 rating from 111 Google reviews, and we would like to earn the next one from you.

## Services
- Water line leak repair: We track down leaking water lines, even when that means digging in the yard, and get the repair done.
- Drain cleaning: Backed-up kitchen and bathroom drains cleared, plus tips to keep them flowing.
- Sewer pipe root clearing and hydro jet: We clear out roots and hydro jet sewer pipes and main stacks so everything drains properly again.
- Water heater replacement: If your water heater is leaking, we check it, recommend what makes sense and give you a fair quote.
- Whole-home water filtration: Installation of whole-home filtration systems, with a walkthrough on how to change the filters.
- Well system and filtration maintenance: Maintenance for homes on well water, explained in simple terms.
- Outdoor faucet repair: Outdoor faucet repairs, with advice on caring for outdoor plumbing in hot weather.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, every day of the week.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We offer both commercial and residential plumbing.

## What customers say
- "After a sewer line backup at my home in Austin, another plumber left a drain snake stuck about 80 feet down in the main sewer line. I called a few plumbing companies, and most told me the snake would need to be located and cut out, which sounded very expensive. I was hoping to find a plumbing team with real drain and sewer experience who could handle the job without turning it into a major repair. The next morning I spoke with a local plumber who listened carefully as I explained the problem. He arrived with another technician, checked the situation, and said he felt confident they could pull the cable out of the main line. They got right to work and were able to remove the stuck snake, which was a huge relief. A few days later, they returned as recommended to clear out the roots and hydro jet the sewer pipe and main stack so everything could drain properly again. They kept me updated during both visits, explained what they were doing, and made sure I understood the next steps. Both plumbers were skilled, professional, and easy to work with. I’m very happy with the service and will definitely call them again for any future plumbing or drain cleaning needs." (Esther Rush, 5/5)
